name: Firststar Volley
description: Loose bolts drawn from the first star that strike the foe in one bright line.

name: Firststar Cover
description: Spread the first star's patient light over yourself and your allies as an unbroken cover.

name: Firststar Mend
description: Let the first star's old gentle light close the gravest wound in yourself or an ally.

name: Firststar Sight
description: Read the whole field as one chart by the first star and tell each foe's place and weakness.

name: Firststar Leap
description: Cross any distance in the field in one leap along the first star's line.

name: Firststar Beam
description: Lay the first star's light on one point of the foe so it wounds from within past any guard.

name: Firststar Judgment
description: Pass the first star's judgment across the field so every foe is struck by its light.

name: Firststar Boon
description: Pour the first star's strength into every ally in the field for the length of a fight.

name: Firststar Descent
description: The school's closing move that brings the first star's light down upon the marked field with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Firststar Oath
description: The school's oath move that binds allies to the first star and guards them with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Firststar Ruin
description: Let the first star's whole light fall on the field at the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Stellar Advent
description: Call the far stars to the field at once so their true light and weight arrive though they stand unmeasured leagues away.
